questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped began they the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begun the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the location?
options: It was in the old castle that the treasure was discovered.
It was in the old castle where the treasure was discovered.
The treasure was discovered in the old castle, that place.
The treasure was discovered in the old castle, which is famous for its history.
questions.answer: It was in the old castle that the treasure was discovered.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical wish.
options: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I was you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the offer.
If I am you, I will accept the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates ellipsis, omitting the repeated words?
options: She speaks English as fluently as he does French.
She speaks English as fluently as he does.
She speaks English as fluently as he does languages.
She speaks English as fluently as he does, but he is better at French.
questions.answer: She speaks English as fluently as he does French.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that appropriately uses a complex sentence structure with a formal register to discuss a scientific topic.
options: Although the experiment failed, the data was still valuable because it provided insights into the phenomenon.
The experiment failed, but the data was valuable because it provided insights into the phenomenon.
The experiment failed, so the data was valuable because it provided insights into the phenomenon.
The experiment failed; however, the data was valuable because it provided insights into the phenomenon.
questions.answer: Although the experiment failed, the data was still valuable because it provided insights into the phenomenon.
